recipes.readme_markdown:
# DaoCloud Enterprise

This recipe generates the `dc` CLI and agent Skill for DaoCloud Enterprise APIs.

The recipe is extracted from the generated
[`DaoCloud/daocloud-skills`](https://github.com/DaoCloud/daocloud-skills)
project and keeps only the reproducible Lathe inputs.

## Modules

- `global-management`: users, groups, workspaces, roles, and audit APIs.
- `container-management`: clusters, namespaces, workloads, and storage APIs.
- `insight`: observability APIs.

## Auth

The generated CLI requires a reachable DCE instance.

Use the generated auth command before executing API operations:

```sh
dc auth login --hostname https://<dce-host>
```

Agents should inspect auth state before executing commands whose catalog detail
has `auth.required=true`:

```sh
dc auth status --hostname https://<dce-host>
```

## Agent workflow

```sh
dc commands schema --json
dc commands --json
dc search "list clusters" --json
dc commands show container-management cluster list-clusters --json
```

Search results are discovery only. Inspect command details before execution.

## Source inputs

The recipe pins DaoCloud OpenAPI specs from:

```text
https://github.com/DaoCloud/daocloud-api-docs.git
```

Recipe overlays live under `overlays/` and are codegen-time polish only.

files.name: cli.yaml
files.content:
cli:
  name: dc
  short: "Command-line tool for DaoCloud Enterprise (DCE)"

auth:
  validate:
    method: GET
    path: /apis/ghippo.io/v1alpha1/current-user

files.name: ghippo.yaml
files.content:
commands:
  # ── 平台内部 API，不对外暴露 ──────────────────────────────────────────
  # BatchAudits
  batch-insert-audits:   { ignore: true }

  # FeatureGate
  get-feature-gate:      { ignore: true }

  # GProducts / GProductLicenses
  list-g-products:             { ignore: true }
  get-g-product:               { ignore: true }
  list-g-product-licenses:     { ignore: true }
  get-g-product-license:       { ignore: true }
  create-g-product-license:    { ignore: true }
  delete-g-product-license:    { ignore: true }
  update-g-product-license:    { ignore: true }

  # KeycloakEvent
  list-keycloak-events:  { ignore: true }

  # LoginPage
  get-login-page:        { ignore: true }
  update-login-page:     { ignore: true }

  # Openapi
  get-open-api:          { ignore: true }

  # ProductNavigator / TopNavigator
  list-product-navigators: { ignore: true }
  get-product-navigator:   { ignore: true }
  update-product-navigator: { ignore: true }
  list-top-navigators:     { ignore: true }
  get-top-navigator:       { ignore: true }
  update-top-navigator:    { ignore: true }

  # Publish
  publish:               { ignore: true }

  # Sms / SmtpSetting
  get-sms-config:        { ignore: true }
  update-sms-config:     { ignore: true }
  send-sms:              { ignore: true }
  get-smtp-setting:      { ignore: true }
  update-smtp-setting:   { ignore: true }
  test-smtp-setting:     { ignore: true }

  # Theme
  list-themes:           { ignore: true }
  get-theme:             { ignore: true }
  update-theme:          { ignore: true }
  create-theme:          { ignore: true }
  delete-theme:          { ignore: true }

  # ── 用户管理 (Users) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  list-users:
    short: "List platform users"
    aliases: [ls-users]
    example: |
      dc global-management users list-users
      dc global-management users list-users --page-size 50 -o json
    params:
      keyword:
        help: "Filter by username or email"
      page:
        default: "1"
      pageSize:
        help: "Number of results per page"
        default: "20"

  create-user:
    short: "Create a new platform user"
    example: |
      dc global-management users create-user \
        --set name=alice \
        --set password=changeme \
        --set description="Alice from dev team" \
        --set temporary=false

  get-user:
    short: "Get user details by ID"
    aliases: [describe-user]

  delete-user:
    short: "Delete a user by ID"

  update-user:
    short: "Update user profile"
    example: |
      dc global-management users update-user --id <id> \
        --set email=newemail@example.com \
        --set firstname=Alice \
        --set lastname=Smith \
        --set description="updated" \
        --set enabled=true

  set-user-password:
    short: "Set or reset a user's password"
    example: |
      dc global-management users set-user-password --id <id> \
        --set password=NewP@ssw0rd

  reset-user-m-f-a:
    short: "Reset MFA for a user"

  list-user-roles:
    short: "List roles assigned to a user"
    params:
      page:
        default: "1"
      pageSize:
        default: "20"

  update-user-roles:
    short: "Assign or update roles for a user"
    example: |
      # Add roles
      echo '{"addRoles":["Admin"],"removeRoles":[]}' | \
        dc global-management users update-user-roles --id <id> --file -
      # Remove roles
      echo '{"addRoles":[],"removeRoles":["Editor"]}' | \
        dc global-management users update-user-roles --id <id> --file -

  list-user-groups:
    short: "List groups a user belongs to"
    params:
      page:
        default: "1"
      pageSize:
        default: "20"

  create-user-access-token:
    short: "Create an access token for a user"
    example: |
      dc global-management users create-user-access-token --id <id> \
        --set name=my-token \
        --set expiredAt=2026-12-31T00:00:00Z

  list-user-access-tokens:
    short: "List access tokens for a user"

  delete-user-access-token:
    short: "Delete an access token"

  # ── 用户组 (Group) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  list-groups:
    short: "List user groups"
    aliases: [ls-groups]
    params:
      page:
        default: "1"
      pageSize:
        default: "20"

  create-group:
    short: "Create a user group"
    example: |
      dc global-management group create-group \
        --set name=dev-team \
        --set description="Development team"

  get-group:
    short: "Get group details"
    aliases: [describe-group]

  delete-group:
    short: "Delete a user group"

  update-group:
    short: "Update a user group"
    example: |
      dc global-management group update-group --id <id> \
        --set name=dev-team-renamed \
        --set description="Renamed team"

  # ── 工作空间 (Workspace) ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  list-workspaces:
    short: "List workspaces"
    aliases: [ls-ws, ls-workspaces]
    example: |
      dc global-management workspace list-workspaces
      dc global-management workspace list-workspaces -o json
    params:
      page:
        default: "1"
      pageSize:
        default: "20"

  create-workspace:
    short: "Create a workspace"
    example: |
      # alias is the display name; parentFolderId=0 places it under root
      dc global-management workspace create-workspace \
        --set alias=my-workspace \
        --set parentFolderId=0

  get-workspace:
    short: "Get workspace details"
    aliases: [describe-workspace]

  delete-workspace:
    short: "Delete a workspace"

  update-workspace:
    short: "Update a workspace"

  list-folders:
    short: "List folders (namespaces within workspaces)"
    aliases: [ls-folders]
    params:
      page:
        default: "1"
      pageSize:
        default: "20"

  create-folder:
    short: "Create a folder"
    example: |
      # alias is the display name; parentFolderId=0 places it under root
      dc global-management workspace create-folder \
        --set alias=my-folder \
        --set parentFolderId=0

  get-folder:
    short: "Get folder details"

  delete-folder:
    short: "Delete a folder"

  update-folder:
    short: "Update a folder"
    example: |
      dc global-management workspace update-folder --folder-id <id> \
        --set alias=new-folder-name

  authorize:
    short: "Grant a role to a user or group within a folder"
    example: |
      dc global-management workspace authorize --folder-id <folderId> \
        --set memberId=<userId> \
        --set memberType=user \
        --set memberName=alice \
        --set-str 'roleNames[0]=Workspace Admin'

  # ── 角色 (Role) ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  list-roles:
    short: "List platform roles"
    aliases: [ls-roles]
    params:
      page:
        default: "1"
      pageSize:
        default: "20"

  create-role:
    short: "Create a custom role"
    example: |
      # scope: platform | folder | workspace
      echo '{
        "name": "my-role",
        "description": "Custom role",
        "scope": "platform",
        "perms": [
          {"gproduct": "ghippo", "resourceType": "User", "action": "get"}
        ]
      }' | dc global-management role create-role --file -

  get-role:
    short: "Get role details"

  delete-role:
    short: "Delete a custom role"

  update-role:
    short: "Update a custom role"
    example: |
      echo '{
        "description": "Updated description",
        "perms": [
          {"gproduct": "ghippo", "resourceType": "User", "action": "get"}
        ]
      }' | dc global-management role update-role --name <name> --file -

  list-all-permissions:
    short: "List all available permissions"
    params:
      page:
        default: "1"
      pageSize:
        default: "20"

  # ── 身份提供商 (IDP / LDAP) ───────────────────────────────────────────
  list-i-d-ps:
    short: "List configured identity providers"
    aliases: [ls-idp]

  create-i-d-p:
    short: "Configure a new identity provider"

  get-i-d-p:
    short: "Get identity provider details"

  delete-i-d-p:
    short: "Remove an identity provider"

  update-i-d-p:
    short: "Update an identity provider"

  list-ldap-config:
    short: "List LDAP configurations"

  # ── 审计 (Audit) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  list-audits:
    short: "List audit log entries"
    aliases: [ls-audit]
    example: |
      dc global-management audit list-audits --page-size 100 -o json
    params:
      page:
        default: "1"
      pageSize:
        default: "20"

  # ── 消息 (Message) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  list-messages:
    short: "List platform messages/notifications"
    params:
      page:
        default: "1"
      pageSize:
        default: "20"

  # ── 安全策略 (SecurityPolicy) ─────────────────────────────────────────
  get-security-policy:
    short: "Get current security policy settings"

  update-security-policy:
    short: "Update security policy settings"

  # ── 分页默认值 (其余分页命令) ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  list-open-sources:
    params:
      page: { default: "1" }
      pageSize: { default: "20" }

  list-csp-audits:

files.name: insight.yaml
files.content:
commands:
  # ── 告警平台内部 API ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Alertmanager 回调入口，不对外暴露
  alert-hook:            { ignore: true }

  # 用不到
  get-net-flow:          { ignore: true }
  get-service-apdex:     { ignore: true }

  # ── 告警 - 告警实例 (Alerts) ──────────────────────────────────────────
  # 通用约定：
  #   - list-* 命令返回 { items: [...], pagination }
  #   - matches / sourceMatchers / targetMatchers 的 type 是枚举字符串：
  #     EQUAL | NOT_EQUAL | REGEXP | MATCH_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED（不是 "=" / "=~"）
  #   - rules[].source 必填，枚举：METRIC_TPL | PROMQL | LOG_TPL | EVENT_TPL
  list-alerts:
    short: "List alerts (active or historical)"
    aliases: [ls-alerts]
    example: |
      # Active alerts in a cluster
      dc insight alert list-alerts --cluster-name prod-1 --severity CRITICAL
      # Alert history (resolved=true)
      dc insight alert list-alerts --resolved=true --page 1 --page-size 50 -o json
      # Filter by group / rule
      dc insight alert list-alerts --group-id <gid> --rule-name "HighCPU"
    params:
      page:      { default: "1" }
      pageSize:  { default: "20" }
      severity:
        help:    "SEVERITY_UNSPECIFIED | CRITICAL | WARNING | INFO"
      targetType:
        help:    "TARGET_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED | GLOBAL | CLUSTER | NAMESPACE | NODE | DEPLOYMENT | STATEFULSET | DAEMONSET | POD"

  get-alert:
    short: "Get a single alert by ID"
    aliases: [describe-alert]
    example: |
      dc insight alert get-alert --id <alertId>
      dc insight alert get-alert --id <alertId> --resolved=true

  count-alert:
    short: "Count alerts grouped by time/severity/target"
    example: |
      # ⚠️ --start 与 --end（unix 秒）必填，缺失返回 HTTP 400 "value must be greater than 0"
      # --step 单位为分钟，0 表示返回时间范围内的总数（不分桶）
      END=$(date +%s); START=$((END - 86400))
      dc insight alert count-alert \
        --cluster-name kpanda-global-cluster \
        --severity CRITICAL \
        --start $START --end $END --step 60 \
        --group-by-type=true -o json

  clean-alert-history:
    short: "Trigger cleanup of alert history (respects retention config)"
    example: |
      dc insight alert clean-alert-history

  # ── 告警 - 告警组 (Group) ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  list-groups:
    short: "List alert groups"
    aliases: [ls-groups]
    example: |
      # All alert groups
      dc insight alert list-groups
      # Filter by name (fuzzy) within a cluster + namespace
      dc insight alert list-groups --name node --cluster-name prod-1 --namespace insight-system
      # Only built-in groups, page through results
      dc insight alert list-groups --builtin=true --page 1 --page-size 50 -o json
    params:
      page:     { default: "1" }
      pageSize: { default: "20" }

  get-group:
    short: "Get an alert group by ID"
    aliases: [describe-group]
    example: |
      dc insight alert get-group --id <gid>
      dc insight alert get-group --id <gid> -o json

  create-group:
    short: "Create an alert group (with rules / receivers)"
    example: |
      # ⚠️ 关键字段：
      #   clusterName  必填
      #   rules[].source 必填，枚举：METRIC_TPL | PROMQL | LOG_TPL | EVENT_TPL
      #     - METRIC_TPL  从指标模板派生（rules[].metricTpl 等）
      #     - PROMQL      自定义 PromQL 表达式（最常用，rules[].expr）
      #     - LOG_TPL     日志告警（额外字段：rules[].logTpl 等）
      #     - EVENT_TPL   事件告警
      #   缺少 source 会创建失败（典型表现：rule source unknown）
      echo '{
        "name": "node-health",
        "clusterName": "kpanda-global-cluster",
        "namespace": "insight-system",
        "description": "Node health alerts",
        "targetType": "NODE",
        "targets": ["*"],
        "receivers": [
          {"type": "email", "names": ["ops-mail"]}
        ],
        "notifyRepeatConfig": [
          {"severity": "CRITICAL", "interval": 300}
        ],
        "rules": [
          {
            "name": "NodeDown",
            "source": "PROMQL",
            "description": "node unreachable for 5m",
            "severity": "CRITICAL",
            "duration": "5m",
            "expr": "up{job=\"node-exporter\"} == 0",
            "labels": {"team": "ops"},
            "annotations": {"summary": "Node {{ $labels.instance }} down"}
          }
        ]
      }' | dc insight alert create-group --file -

  update-group:
    short: "Update an alert group (description / receivers / notify only)"
    example: |
      echo '{
        "description": "updated",
        "notificationTemplate": "default",
        "receivers": [{"type":"email","names":["ops-mail"]}],
        "notifyRepeatConfig": [{"severity":"WARNING","interval":600}]
      }' | dc insight alert update-group --id <gid> --file -

  delete-group:
    short: "Delete an alert group"
    example: |
      dc insight alert delete-group --id <gid>

  validate-group:
    short: "Validate a group definition (PrometheusRule YAML)"
    example: |
      echo '{
        "clusterName": "prod-1",
        "namespace": "insight-system",
        "yamlString": "groups:\n- name: my\n  rules:\n  - alert: A\n    expr: vector(1)\n"
      }' | dc insight alert validate-group --file -

  # ── 告警 - 告警规则 (GroupRule) ───────────────────────────────────────
  list-group-rules:
    short: "List rules under an alert group"
    aliases: [ls-group-rules]
    example: |
      # All rules in a group
      dc insight alert list-group-rules --id <gid>
      # Filter by name + severity
      dc insight alert list-group-rules --id <gid> --name HighCPU --severity CRITICAL
      # Only firing rules, paged
      dc insight alert list-group-rules --id <gid> --status FIRING --page 1 --page-size 50 -o json
    params:
      page:     { default: "1" }
      pageSize: { default: "20" }
      severity: { help: "SEVERITY_UNSPECIFIED | CRITICAL | WARNING | INFO" }
      status:   { help: "UNSPECIFIED | FIRING | ENABLED" }

  get-group-rule:
    short: "Get a single rule by group id + rule name"
    example: |
      dc insight alert get-group-rule --id <gid> --name HighCPU

  add-group-rule:
    short: "Add a rule to an existing group"
    example: |
      # rule.source 必填（METRIC_TPL | PROMQL | LOG_TPL | EVENT_TPL），见 create-group 说明
      echo '{
        "rule": {
          "name": "HighMem",
          "source": "PROMQL",
          "severity": "WARNING",
          "duration": "5m",
          "expr": "node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes < 0.1",
          "description": "memory low",
          "labels": {"team":"ops"},
          "annotations": {"summary":"low memory on {{ $labels.instance }}"}
        }
      }' | dc insight alert add-group-rule --id <gid> --file -

  update-group-rule:
    short: "Update a rule in a group"
    example: |
      echo '{
        "source":   "PROMQL",
        "severity": "CRITICAL",
        "duration": "10m",
        "expr": "rate(http_requests_total{code=~\"5..\"}[5m]) > 1",
        "description": "5xx rate too high"
      }' | dc insight alert update-group-rule --id <gid> --name HighErr --file -

  delete-group-rule:
    short: "Delete a rule from a group"
    example: |
      dc insight alert delete-group-rule --id <gid> --name HighCPU

  preview-rule:
    short: "Preview a rule's evaluation (matrix output) before saving"
    example: |
      # rule.source 必填（同 create-group / add-group-rule）；params 时间为 unix 秒字符串
      END=$(date +%s); START=$((END - 3600))
      echo '{
        "group": {"clusterName":"kpanda-global-cluster","targetType":"CLUSTER","targets":["*"]},
        "rule":  {"source":"PROMQL","expr":"vector(1)","duration":"1m","severity":"WARNING"},
        "params":{"start":"'"$START"'","end":"'"$END"'","step":60}
      }' | dc insight alert preview-rule --file -

  # ── 告警 - 通知接收人 (Receiver) ──────────────────────────────────────
  list-receivers:
    short: "List notification receivers"
    aliases: [ls-receivers]
    example: |
      # All receivers
      dc insight alert list-receivers
      # Only email receivers, exact name match
      dc insight alert list-receivers --type email --name ops-mail --exact-search=true
      # Paged JSON output
      dc insight alert list-receivers --page 1 --page-size 50 -o json
    params:
      page:     { default: "1" }
      pageSize: { default: "20" }
      type:     { help: "RECEIVER_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED | webhook | email | dingtalk | wecom | sms | message | lark" }

  get-receiver:
    short: "Get a receiver by name + type"
    aliases: [describe-receiver]
    example: |
      # ⚠️ --type 必填（proto enum.defined_only），缺失返回 HTTP 400 "type cannot be empty"
      # type 取值：webhook | email | dingtalk | wecom | sms | message | lark
      dc insight alert get-receiver --name ops-mail --type email -o json
      dc insight alert get-receiver --name my-bot   --type lark  -o json
    params:
      type: { help: "Required. webhook | email | dingtalk | wecom | sms | message | lark" }

  create-receiver:
    short: "Create a notification receiver (email/dingtalk/wecom/webhook/lark/sms/message)"
    example: |
      # Email receiver
      echo '{
        "name": "ops-mail",
        "type": "email",
        "description": "ops mailing list",
        "email": {"to": ["ops@example.com"]}
      }' | dc insight alert create-receiver --file -

      # Webhook receiver with bearer token
      echo '{
        "name": "my-webhook",
        "type": "webhook",
        "webhook": {
          "url": "https://hooks.example.com/insight",
          "httpConfig": {
            "bearerToken": "xxx",
            "tlsConfig": {"insecureSkipVerify": false}
          }
        }
      }' | dc insight alert create-receiver --file -

  update-receiver:
    short: "Update a notification receiver"
    example: |
      echo '{
        "name": "ops-mail",
        "type": "email",
        "description": "updated mailing list",
        "email": {"to": ["ops@example.com", "oncall@example.com"]}
      }' | dc insight alert update-receiver --name ops-mail --file -

  delete-receiver:
    short: "Delete a notification receiver"
    example: |
      dc insight alert delete-receiver --name ops-mail

  test-receiver:
    short: "Send a test message to a receiver definition"
    example: |
      echo '{
        "name": "ops-mail",
        "type": "email",
        "email": {"to": ["ops@example.com"]}
      }' | dc insight alert test-receiver --file -

  get-smtp-status:
    short: "Check whether SMTP is configured (required for email receivers)"
    example: |
      dc insight alert get-smtp-status
      dc insight alert get-smtp-status -o json

  # ── 告警 - SMS Provider ───────────────────────────────────────────────

    params:

  get-provider:

      dc insight alert get-provider --name aliyun-sms

  create-provider:
    short: "Create an SMS provider"
    example: |
      echo '{
        "name": "aliyun-sms",
        "type": "aliyun",
        "template": "default",
        "aliyun": {
          "accessKeyId": "AKID...",
          "accessKeySecret": "SECRET...",

        "template": "default",

  # ── 告警 - 通知模板 (Template) ────────────────────────────────────────
  list-templates:
    short: "List notification templates"
    aliases: [ls-templates]
    example: |
      dc insight alert list-templates
      dc insight alert list-templates --name crit --exact-search=false
      dc insight alert list-templates --builtin=true --page 1 --page-size 50 -o json
    params:
      page:     { default: "1" }
      pageSize: { default: "20" }

  list-template-summary:
    short: "List notification template summaries (lightweight)"
    example: |
      dc insight alert list-template-summary
      dc insight alert list-template-summary --builtin=true -o json
    params:
      page:     { default: "1" }
      pageSize: { default: "20" }

  get-template:
    short: "Get a notification template by name"
    example: |
      dc insight alert get-template --name crit-email
      dc insight alert get-template --name crit-email -o json

  create-template:
    short: "Create a notification template (body per channel)"
    example: |
      echo '{
        "name": "crit-email",
        "description": "critical alert template",
        "body": {
          "email": {
            "subject": "[CRITICAL] {{ .CommonLabels.alertname }}",
            "body": "{{ range .Alerts }}{{ .Annotations.summary }}\n{{ end }}"
          },
          "dingtalk": "**[CRITICAL]** {{ .CommonLabels.alertname }}",
          "wecom": "[CRITICAL] {{ .CommonLabels.alertname }}"
        }
      }' | dc insight alert create-template --file -

  update-template:
    short: "Update a notification template"
    example: |
      echo '{
        "description": "updated critical template",
        "body": {
          "email": {
            "subject": "[CRITICAL] {{ .CommonLabels.alertname }}",
            "body":    "{{ range .Alerts }}{{ .Annotations.summary }}\n{{ end }}"
          }
        }
      }' | dc insight alert update-template --name crit-email --file -

  delete-template:
    short: "Delete a notification template"
    example: |
      dc insight alert delete-template --name crit-email

  preview-template:
    short: "Render a notification template against sample alert data"
    example: |
      # ⚠️ data 字段使用 commonLabels（驼峰），不是 labels；alerts[] 必填
      # 模板里 {{ .CommonLabels.X }} 对应 body 输入的 data.commonLabels.X
      echo '{
        "body": {"email":{"subject":"[T] {{ .CommonLabels.alertname }}","body":"x"}},
        "data": {
          "status": "firing",
          "commonLabels": {"alertname":"HighCPU"},
          "alerts": [{"status":"firing","labels":{"instance":"node1"},"annotations":{"summary":"cpu hot"}}]
        }
      }' | dc insight alert preview-template --file -

  # ── 告警 - 规则模板 (RuleTemplate) ────────────────────────────────────
  list-rule-templates:
    short: "List alert rule templates (reusable rule bundles)"
    example: |
      dc insight alert list-rule-templates
      dc insight alert list-rule-templates --target-type NODE --builtin=false
      dc insight alert list-rule-templates --name node --page 1 --page-size 50 -o json
    params:
      page:     { default: "1" }
      pageSize: { default: "20" }
      targetType:
        help: "TARGET_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED | GLOBAL | CLUSTER | NAMESPACE | NODE | DEPLOYMENT | STATEFULSET | DAEMONSET | POD"

  list-rule-template-summary:
    short: "List rule template summaries (id/name/targetType only)"
    example: |
      dc insight alert list-rule-template-summary
      dc insight alert list-rule-template-summary --target-type CLUSTER -o json

  get-rule-template:
    short: "Get a rule template by ID"
    example: |
      dc insight alert get-rule-template --id <rtid>
      dc insight alert get-rule-template --id <rtid> -o json

  create-rule-template:
    short: "Create a rule template (bundle of rules)"
    example: |
      echo '{
        "name": "node-basics",
        "description": "basic node alerts",
        "targetType": "NODE",
        "rules": [
          {"name":"NodeDown","severity":"CRITICAL","duration":"5m","expr":"up == 0"},
          {"name":"NodeHighLoad","severity":"WARNING","duration":"10m","expr":"node_load5 > 8"}
        ]
      }' | dc insight alert create-rule-template --file -

  update-rule-template:
    short: "Update a rule template"
    example: |
      echo '{
        "description": "updated node basics",
        "rules": [
          {"name":"NodeDown","severity":"CRITICAL","duration":"10m","expr":"up == 0"},
          {"name":"NodeHighLoad","severity":"WARNING","duration":"15m","expr":"node_load5 > 10"}
        ]
      }' | dc insight alert update-rule-template --id <rtid> --file -

  delete-rule-template:
    short: "Delete a rule template"
    example: |
      dc insight alert delete-rule-template --id <rtid>

  # ── 告警 - 静默 (Silence) ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  list-silences:
    short: "List alert silences"
    aliases: [ls-silences]
    example: |
      # All silences (active and expired)
      dc insight alert list-silences
      # Only currently-active silences
      dc insight alert list-silences --expired=false
      # Filter by cluster + namespace
      dc insight alert list-silences --cluster-name prod-1 --namespace insight-system -o json

  get-silence:
    short: "Get a silence by ID"
    example: |
      dc insight alert get-silence --id <sid>
      dc insight alert get-silence --id <sid> -o json

  create-silence:
    short: "Create an alert silence (label matchers + optional schedule)"
    example: |
      # ⚠️ matches[].type 是枚举字符串，不是 "=" / "=~"。可选：
      #   EQUAL | NOT_EQUAL | REGEXP | MATCH_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED
      echo '{
        "name": "maint-window",
        "clusterName": "kpanda-global-cluster",
        "namespace": "insight-system",
        "description": "weekly maintenance",
        "matches": [
          {"type": "EQUAL",  "key": "alertname", "value": "HighCPU"},
          {"type": "REGEXP", "key": "instance",  "value": "node-.*"}
        ],
        "activeTimeInterval": {
          "weekdayRange": [0],
          "timeRanges": [{"start":"02:00","end":"04:00"}]
        }
      }' | dc insight alert create-silence --file -

  update-silence:
    short: "Update an alert silence"
    example: |
      echo '{
        "description": "extended maintenance window",
        "matches": [
          {"type": "EQUAL",  "key": "alertname", "value": "HighCPU"},
          {"type": "REGEXP", "key": "instance",  "value": "node-.*"}
        ],
        "activeTimeInterval": {
          "weekdayRange": [0, 6],
          "timeRanges": [{"start":"01:00","end":"05:00"}]
        }
      }' | dc insight alert update-silence --id <sid> --file -

  delete-silence:
    short: "Delete an alert silence"
    example: |
      dc insight alert delete-silence --id <sid>

  preview-silence:
    short: "Preview which alerts a silence definition would match"
    example: |
      # matches[].type 同 create-silence：EQUAL / NOT_EQUAL / REGEXP
      echo '{
        "clusterName": "kpanda-global-cluster",
        "namespace": "insight-system",
        "size": "20",
        "matches": [{"type":"EQUAL","key":"alertname","value":"HighCPU"}]
      }' | dc insight alert preview-silence --file -

  # ── 告警 - 抑制 (Inhibition) ──────────────────────────────────────────
  list-inhibitions:
    short: "List inhibition rules"
    aliases: [ls-inhibitions]
    example: |
      dc insight alert list-inhibitions
      dc insight alert list-inhibitions --cluster-name prod-1 --namespace insight-system
      dc insight alert list-inhibitions --name cluster-down --page 1 --page-size 50 -o json
    params:
      page:     { default: "1" }
      pageSize: { default: "20" }

  get-inhibition:
    short: "Get an inhibition by ID"
    example: |
      dc insight alert get-inhibition --id <iid>
      dc insight alert get-inhibition --id <iid> -o json

  create-inhibition:
    short: "Create an inhibition rule (source matchers suppress target matchers)"
    example: |
      echo '{
        "name": "cluster-down-suppresses-node",
        "clusterName": "prod-1",
        "namespace": "insight-system",
        "description": "if cluster is down, suppress node-level alerts",
        "equal": ["clusterName"],
        "sourceMatchers": [{"type":"EQUAL","key":"alertname","value":"ClusterDown"}],
        "targetMatchers": [{"type":"EQUAL","key":"severity","value":"WARNING"}]
      }' | dc insight alert create-inhibition --file -

      # matches/sourceMatchers/targetMatchers 的 type 同 silence：EQUAL / NOT_EQUAL / REGEXP

  update-inhibition:
    short: "Update an inhibition rule"
    example: |
      echo '{
        "description": "updated suppression",
        "equal": ["clusterName", "namespace"],
        "sourceMatchers": [{"type":"EQUAL", "key":"alertname","value":"ClusterDown"}],
        "targetMatchers": [{"type":"REGEXP","key":"severity","value":"WARNING|INFO"}]
      }' | dc insight alert update-inhibition --id <iid> --file -

  delete-inhibition:
    short: "Delete an inhibition rule"
    example: |
      dc insight alert delete-inhibition --id <iid>

  # ── 日志 (Log) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # 日志分两类（event 已废弃）：
  #   - resource: 容器 / 工作负载日志（kubernetes 标签）
  #   - system:   节点系统日志（syslog / /var/log/*）
  #
  # 时间字段（startTime / endTime / nanotimestamp）一律使用 RFC3339Nano，
  # 例：2026-05-21T00:00:00.000000000Z
  #
  # clusterFilter 接受 **集群 UUID (kube-system 命名空间的 UID)**，不是集群名。
  # 每次查询只能传一个 UUID；namespaceFilter 必须配合 clusterFilter 使用。
  # 取 UUID：
  #   dc insight resource get-cluster --name kpanda-global-cluster -o json \
  #     | jq -r .kubeSystemId
  # 下文示例统一使用占位 <KUBESYSTEMID>，请替换为该命令返回值。
  query-log:
    short: "Query container or system logs with filters and pagination"
    example: |
      # 1) 先拿到集群 UUID
      KUBESYSTEMID=$(dc insight resource get-cluster --name kpanda-global-cluster -o json | jq -r .kubeSystemId)

      # 2) 容器日志：在 kpanda-global-cluster / insight-system 中检索包含 "error" 的日志
      # 字段说明（resource filter）：
      #   clusterFilter    集群 UUID 列表，必填且只能 1 个
      #   namespaceFilter  命名空间精确匹配（需配合 clusterFilter）
      #   workloadFilter   工作负载精确匹配；workloadSearch 为模糊
      #   podFilter        Pod 精确匹配；podSearch 为模糊
      #   containerFilter  容器精确匹配；containerSearch 为模糊
      #   logSearch        日志正文关键字（多值 AND）
      #   traceIdSearch    精确匹配 trace_id
      #   luceneFilter     Lucene DSL，可选键：
      #                    kubernetes.namespace_name.keyword / kubernetes.pod_name.keyword /
      #                    kubernetes.container_name.keyword / trace_id.keyword / log
      # 顶层字段：
      #   startTime/endTime  RFC3339Nano，可空表示无界
      #   page/pageSize      分页（默认 1/10，pageSize 软上限 100）
      #   sorts              仅支持 time 字段；格式 "time,desc" 或 "time,asc"，默认 "time,desc"
      echo '{
        "startTime": "2026-05-21T00:00:00.000000000Z",
        "endTime":   "2026-05-21T01:00:00.000000000Z",
        "page": 1,
        "pageSize": 100,
        "sorts": ["time,desc"],
        "resource": {
          "clusterFilter":   ["'"$KUBESYSTEMID"'"],
          "namespaceFilter": ["insight-system"],
          "workloadFilter":  ["insight-server"],
          "podSearch":       ["insight-server"],
          "logSearch":       ["error"],
          "luceneFilter":    "kubernetes.container_name.keyword:insight-server AND log:error"
        }
      }' | dc insight log query-log --file -

      # 3) 系统日志（节点 syslog）
      # system filter 支持键：nodeFilter / fileFilter / logSearch / luceneFilter
      # luceneFilter 可用键：syslog.host.keyword / syslog.file.keyword / syslog.ident.keyword / log
      echo '{
        "startTime": "2026-05-21T00:00:00.000000000Z",
        "endTime":   "2026-05-21T01:00:00.000000000Z",
        "system": {
          "clusterFilter": ["'"$KUBESYSTEMID"'"],
          "nodeFilter":    ["node-1"],
          "fileFilter":    ["/var/log/messages"],
          "logSearch":     ["oom"]
        }
      }' | dc insight log query-log --file -

      # 返回结构（items 数组每条）：
      #   timestamp                 RFC3339Nano，可直接作为 query-log-context 的 nanotimestamp
      #   log                       日志正文
      #   labels.cluster            集群 UUID
      #   labels.namespace          命名空间（resource filter 时）
      #   labels.pod                Pod 名称
      #   labels.container          容器名称
      #   labels.node / labels.file 节点 / 文件（system filter 时）

  query-log-context:
    short: "Fetch lines before/after a specific log entry (context view)"
    example: |
      KUBESYSTEMID=$(dc insight resource get-cluster --name kpanda-global-cluster -o json | jq -r .kubeSystemId)

      # 容器日志上下文
      # 字段说明：
      #   before/after    锚点前/后行数，范围 [0,10000]，至少一个 > 0
      #   nanotimestamp   锚点行的 RFC3339Nano 时间戳（必填）
      #   startTime/endTime  搜索窗口（可选）
      #   resource filter (全部必填)：cluster=集群 UUID, namespace, pod, container
      #
      # 推荐流程：先用 query-log 取锚点，再用 jq 提取 timestamp 与 labels.* 作为参数
      LOG_RESULT=$(echo '{
        "startTime": "2026-05-21T00:00:00.000000000Z",
        "endTime":   "2026-05-21T01:00:00.000000000Z",
        "page": 1, "pageSize": 1,
        "resource": {
          "clusterFilter": ["'"$KUBESYSTEMID"'"],
          "logSearch": ["error"]
        }
      }' | dc insight log query-log --file - -o json)

      TS=$(echo "$LOG_RESULT" | jq -r '.items[0].timestamp')
      NS=$(echo "$LOG_RESULT" | jq -r '.items[0].labels.namespace')
      POD=$(echo "$LOG_RESULT" | jq -r '.items[0].labels.pod')
      CT=$(echo "$LOG_RESULT" | jq -r '.items[0].labels.container')

      echo '{
        "before": 50,
        "after":  50,
        "startTime":     "2026-05-21T00:00:00.000000000Z",
        "endTime":       "2026-05-21T01:00:00.000000000Z",
        "nanotimestamp": "'"$TS"'",
        "resource": {
          "cluster":   "'"$KUBESYSTEMID"'",
          "namespace": "'"$NS"'",
          "pod":       "'"$POD"'",
          "container": "'"$CT"'"
        }
      }' | dc insight log query-log-context --file -

      # 系统日志上下文（system filter 三字段全部必填：cluster / node / file）
      echo '{
        "before": 30,
        "after":  30,
        "startTime":     "2026-05-21T00:00:00.000000000Z",
        "endTime":       "2026-05-21T01:00:00.000000000Z",
        "nanotimestamp": "2026-05-21T00:30:12.123456789Z",
        "system": {
          "cluster": "'"$KUBESYSTEMID"'",
          "node":    "node-1",
          "file":    "/var/log/messages"
        }
      }' | dc insight log query-log-context --file -

  query-log-histogram:
    short: "Bucket log counts over time (histogram)"
    example: |
      KUBESYSTEMID=$(dc insight resource get-cluster --name kpanda-global-cluster -o json | jq -r .kubeSystemId)

      # 字段说明：
      #   startTime/endTime  RFC3339Nano（必填）
      #   interval           ES date_histogram 间隔，如 "1m"/"5m"/"1h"（必填）
      #   resource/system    与 query-log 相同的 filter 二选一
      echo '{
        "startTime": "2026-05-21T00:00:00.000000000Z",
        "endTime":   "2026-05-21T01:00:00.000000000Z",
        "interval":  "1m",
        "resource": {
          "clusterFilter":   ["'"$KUBESYSTEMID"'"],
          "namespaceFilter": ["insight-system"],
          "logSearch":       ["error"]
        }
      }' | dc insight log query-log-histogram --file -

  search-log:
    short: "Raw Elasticsearch DSL passthrough (advanced)"
    example: |
      # --index 传 ILM 索引后缀（服务端会补前缀），常用 "insight-logs-*"
      # --query 必须是合法的 ES DSL JSON 字符串
      dc insight log search-log \
        --index 'insight-logs-*' \
        --query '{"query":{"match":{"log":"timeout"}}}'

      # 在 insight-system 命名空间内查最近 1h 含 "error" 的日志
      dc insight log search-log \
        --index 'insight-logs-*' \
        --query '{
          "size": 100,
          "sort": [{"@timestamp":"desc"}],
          "query": {
            "bool": {
              "must":   [{"match": {"log": "error"}}],
              "filter": [
                {"term":  {"kubernetes.namespace_name.keyword": "insight-system"}},
                {"range": {"@timestamp": {"gte": "now-1h", "lte": "now"}}}
              ]
            }
          }
        }' -o json

  list-log-file-paths:
    short: "List system log file paths discovered on a node"
    aliases: [ls-log-file-paths]
    example: |
      # 用集群名（服务端解析为 UUID）
      dc insight log list-log-file-paths --cluster-name kpanda-global-cluster --node node-1
      # 或直接传 UUID
      KUBESYSTEMID=$(dc insight resource get-cluster --name kpanda-global-cluster -o json | jq -r .kubeSystemId)
      dc insight log list-log-file-paths --cluster "$KUBESYSTEMID" --node node-1 -o json

  download-log:
    short: "Export logs (or a context window) to a downloadable file"
    example: |
      KUBESYSTEMID=$(dc insight resource get-cluster --name kpanda-global-cluster -o json | jq -r .kubeSystemId)

      # 字段说明：
      #   type            导出格式枚举：TEXT(默认) / CSV / JSON
      #   maxLines        导出上限 [0,10000]，0 视为 2000
      #   fields          列枚举（TEXT/CSV 生效；JSON 输出完整记录），可选值：
      #                   Timestamp | Cluster | Namespace | Pod | Container | Node | File
      #   sorts           仅支持 "time,desc"（默认）或 "time,asc"
      #   timeZone        导出时间戳的 IANA 时区，如 "Asia/Shanghai"
      #   queryLog        或 queryLogContext，二选一（结构同 query-log / query-log-context）
      echo '{
        "type": "CSV",
        "maxLines": 5000,
        "fields": ["Timestamp", "Cluster", "Namespace", "Pod", "Container"],
        "sorts": ["time,asc"],
        "timeZone": "Asia/Shanghai",
        "queryLog": {
          "startTime": "2026-05-21T00:00:00.000000000Z",
          "endTime":   "2026-05-21T01:00:00.000000000Z",
          "sorts":     ["time,asc"],
          "resource": {
            "clusterFilter":   ["'"$KUBESYSTEMID"'"],
            "namespaceFilter": ["insight-system"],
            "workloadFilter":  ["insight-server"]
          }
        }
      }' | dc insight log download-log --file -

      # 导出某条日志的上下文窗口
      echo '{
        "type": "TEXT",
        "maxLines": 200,
        "fields": ["Timestamp", "Pod", "Container"],
        "queryLogContext": {
          "before": 100,
          "after":  100,
          "startTime":     "2026-05-21T00:00:00.000000000Z",
          "endTime":       "2026-05-21T01:00:00.000000000Z",
          "nanotimestamp": "2026-05-21T00:30:12.123456789Z",
          "resource": {
            "cluster":   "'"$KUBESYSTEMID"'",
            "namespace": "insight-system",
            "pod":       "insight-server-0",
            "container": "insight-server"
          }
        }
      }' | dc insight log download-log --file -

  # ── 指标 (Metric) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # 透传 Prometheus 查询 API；time / start / end 单位为 unix 秒 (int64)，step 为秒 (double)。
  # 集群参数：--cluster-name 传集群名；--cluster 传集群 UUID（kubeSystemId），二选一。
  query-metric:
    short: "Run a PromQL instant query (Prometheus /api/v1/query)"
    example: |
      # 用集群名 - 当前所有 targets 的 up 状态
      dc insight metric query-metric \
        --cluster-name kpanda-global-cluster \
        --query 'up' -o json

      # 用集群 UUID（与 --cluster-name 二选一）
      KUBESYSTEMID=$(dc insight resource get-cluster --name kpanda-global-cluster -o json | jq -r .kubeSystemId)
      dc insight metric query-metric --cluster "$KUBESYSTEMID" --query 'up' -o json

      # 指定命名空间 + 时间戳（unix 秒）的瞬时 CPU 查询
      dc insight metric query-metric \
        --cluster-name kpanda-global-cluster \
        --namespace insight-system \
        --query 'sum(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="insight-system"}[5m])) by (pod)' \
        --time 1747850400 -o json

      # 返回结构：vector 数组，每项 { metric: {labels}, values: { timestamp, value } }

  query-range-metric:
    short: "Run a PromQL range query (Prometheus /api/v1/query_range)"
    example: |
      # 最近 1 小时 up 指标，30s 采样
      END=$(date +%s); START=$((END - 3600))
      dc insight metric query-range-metric \
        --cluster-name kpanda-global-cluster \
        --query 'up' \
        --start $START --end $END --step 30 -o json

      # insight-system 命名空间内 Pod CPU 使用率
      dc insight metric query-range-metric \
        --cluster-name kpanda-global-cluster \
        --namespace insight-system \
        --query 'sum(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total[5m])) by (pod)' \
        --start $START --end $END --step 60 -o json

      # 字段说明：
      #   --start/--end  unix 秒 (int64)
      #   --step         采样间隔秒 (double)，可传小数
      # 返回结构：matrix 数组，每项 { metric: {labels}, values: [{timestamp,value}, ...] }

  batch-query-metric:
    short: "Run multiple PromQL instant queries in one call (shared label match)"
    example: |
      # matchLabel 字段说明：
      #   clusterName  集群名（与 cluster 二选一）
      #   cluster      集群 UUID（与 clusterName 二选一）
      #   namespace    可选
      #   extraLabel   附加 label 过滤（map<string,string>），会注入到每条 query
      # param.time     unix 秒
      # queryList      PromQL 数组，非空
      echo '{
        "matchLabel": {
          "clusterName": "kpanda-global-cluster",
          "namespace":   "insight-system"
        },
        "param": {"time": '"$(date +%s)"'},
        "queryList": [
          "up",
          "sum(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total[5m]))"
        ]
      }' | dc insight metric batch-query-metric --file - -o json

      # 返回结构：
      #   data[].data.vector[]  与 query-metric 同结构
      #   data[].status         SUCCESS | FAIL
      #   data[].errorMessage   失败时的错误信息
      # data 数组按 queryList 顺序一一对应。

  batch-query-range-metric:
    short: "Run multiple PromQL range queries in one call (shared label match)"
    example: |
      # param.start/end 为 unix 秒，step 为秒 (double)
      END=$(date +%s); START=$((END - 3600))
      echo '{
        "matchLabel": {
          "clusterName": "kpanda-global-cluster",
          "namespace":   "insight-system"
        },
        "param": {"start": '"$START"', "end": '"$END"', "step": 60},
        "queryList": [
          "up",
          "sum(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total[5m]))"
        ]
      }' | dc insight metric batch-query-range-metric --file - -o json

      # 返回结构：
      #   data[].data.matrix[]  与 query-range-metric 同结构
      #   data[].status         SUCCESS | FAIL
      #   data[].errorMessage
      # data 数组按 queryList 顺序一一对应。

  format-query:
    short: "Pretty-print / normalize a PromQL expression (server-side formatter)"
    example: |
      echo '{"query":"sum(rate(http_requests_total{code=~\"5..\"}[5m]))/sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m]))"}' \
        | dc insight metric format-query --file - -o json

      # 返回结构：{ "query": "<格式化后的 PromQL>" }（对象，非数组）

  # ── 资源 (Resource) ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # 通用约定：
  #   - list-* 命令返回 { items: [...], pagination }
  #   - get-* 命令返回单条资源详情
  #   - --cluster 同时接受集群名 (kpanda-global-cluster) 或集群 UUID (kubeSystemId)

    params:
      page:     { default: "1" }
      pageSize: { default: "20" }
      phase:    { help: "CLUSTER_PHASE_UNSPECIFIED | UNKNOWN | CREATING | RUNNING | UPDATING | DELETING | FAILED" }

  get-cluster:

    example: |

      dc insight resource list-namespaces --cluster kpanda-global-cluster -o json

  get-namespace:

    params:

  get-node:

    aliases: [describe-node]
    example: |

  get-node-gpu-dashboards:

    example: |

  # Pod
  list-pods:

    example: |

  get-pod:
    short: "Get pod details by cluster + namespace + name"
    aliases: [describe-pod]
    example: |
      dc insight resource get-pod --cluster prod-1 --namespace default --name my-app-abc123
      dc insight resource get-pod --cluster prod-1 --namespace default --name my-app-abc123 -o json

  get-pod-metrics:
    short: "Get pod metrics over a time range (CPU / memory / network)"
    example: |
      # 时间格式：--start / --end 同时接受 unix 秒 (int) 或 RFC3339 字符串
      # --step 单位为秒
      END=$(date +%s); START=$((END - 3600))

      # 最近 1 小时，30s 步长
      dc insight resource get-pod-metrics \
        --cluster kpanda-global-cluster --namespace kube-system \
        --name coredns-6d4d6f8c7-x8zvw \
        --start $START --end $END --step 30 -o json

      # 指定 metric 子集（PromQL-like keys，服务端定义）
      dc insight resource get-pod-metrics \
        --cluster kpanda-global-cluster --namespace kube-system \
        --name coredns-6d4d6f8c7-x8zvw \
        --start $START --end $END --step 30 \
        --query-list cpuUsage --query-list memoryUsage -o json

      # 输出：.metrics 字段（按 metric key 分组的时序数据）

  get-pod-gpu-dashboards:
    short: "Get GPU dashboard URLs for a pod"
    example: |
      dc insight resource get-pod-gpu-dashboards \
        --cluster prod-1 --namespace default --name my-gpu-pod

  get-pod-jvm-dashboards:
    short: "Get JVM dashboard URLs for a pod (Java workloads)"
    example: |
      dc insight resource get-pod-jvm-dashboards \
        --cluster prod-1 --namespace default --name my-java-pod \

  list-pod-containers:
    short: "List containers within a pod"
    aliases: [ls-pod-containers]
    example: |
      dc insight resource list-pod-containers \
        --cluster prod-1 --namespace default --name my-app-abc123
      dc insight resource list-pod-containers \
        --cluster prod-1 --namespace default --name my-app-abc123 \
        --page 1 --page-size 50 -o json
    params:
      page:     { default: "1" }
      pageSize: { default: "20" }

  # 工作负载 - Deployment
  list-deployments:
    short: "List Deployments in a cluster"
    aliases: [ls-deployments]
    example: |
      dc insight resource list-deployments --cluster kpanda-global-cluster
      dc insight resource list-deployments --cluster kpanda-global-cluster --namespace kube-system \
        --phase WORKLOAD_STATE_NOT_READY -o json

      # 输出：.items[] 主要字段 name / namespace / tracingEnabled

    params:

      pageSize: { default: "20" }

  get-deployment:

    aliases: [describe-deployment]
    example: |

  get-deployment-pods:

      dc insight resource get-deployment-pods \
        --cluster prod-1 --namespace default --name my-app \
        --pod my-app-abc --page 1 --page-size 50 -o json
    params:
      page:     { default: "1" }
      pageSize: { default: "20" }

  # 工作负载 - StatefulSet
  list-statefulsets:

      pageSize: { default: "20" }
      phase:    { help: "WORKLOAD_STATE_UNKNOWN | WORKLOAD_STATE_RUNNING | WORKLOAD_STATE_DELETING | WORKLOAD_STATE_NOT_READY | WORKLOAD_STATE_STOPPED | WORKLOAD_STATE_WAITING" }

  get-statefulset:

  get-statefulset-pods:

    example: |
      dc insight resource get-statefulset-pods \

    params:

  # 工作负载 - DaemonSet
  list-daemonsets:

    example: |

    params:

      phase:    { help: "WORKLOAD_STATE_UNKNOWN | WORKLOAD_STATE_RUNNING | WORKLOAD_STATE_DELETING | WORKLOAD_STATE_NOT_READY | WORKLOAD_STATE_STOPPED | WORKLOAD_STATE_WAITING" }

  get-daemonset:

    aliases: [describe-daemonset]
    example: |

  get-daemonset-pods:
    short: "List pods belonging to a DaemonSet"
    example: |
      dc insight resource get-daemonset-pods \
        --cluster prod-1 --namespace kube-system --name fluent-bit \
        --page 1 --page-size 50 -o json
    params:

  # 工作负载 - Job / CronJob
  list-jobs:
    short: "List Jobs in a cluster"
    aliases: [ls-jobs]
    example: |
      dc insight resource list-jobs --cluster prod-1
      dc insight resource list-jobs --cluster prod-1 --namespace default \
        --phase JOB_STATE_FAILED -o json
    params:
      page:     { default: "1" }
      pageSize: { default: "20" }
      phase:    { help: "JOB_STATE_UNSPECIFIED | JOB_STATE_WAITING | JOB_STATE_RUNNING | JOB_STATE_COMPLETED | JOB_STATE_DELETING | JOB_STATE_FAILED" }

  get-job:

    aliases: [describe-job]

      dc insight resource get-job --cluster prod-1 --namespace default --name backup-20240101

  get-job-pods:
    short: "List pods belonging to a Job"
    example: |
      dc insight resource get-job-pods \
        --cluster prod-1 --namespace default --name backup-20240101 \

    params:

      pageSize: { default: "20" }

  list-cronjobs:
    short: "List CronJobs in a cluster"
    aliases: [ls-cronjobs]

    params:

      phase:    { help: "JOB_STATE_UNSPECIFIED | JOB_STATE_WAITING | JOB_STATE_RUNNING | JOB_STATE_COMPLETED | JOB_STATE_DELETING | JOB_STATE_FAILED" }

  get-cronjob:
    short: "Get a CronJob by cluster + namespace + name"
    aliases: [describe-cronjob]
    example: |
      dc insight resource get-cronjob --cluster prod-1 --namespace default --name nightly-backup

  get-cronjob-pods:
    short: "List pods spawned by a CronJob"
    example: |
      dc insight resource get-cronjob-pods \
        --cluster prod-1 --namespace default --name nightly-backup \

    params:
      page:     { default: "1" }
